lessons: Production code is close: EXIT_TICKET is now imported, venv uses sys.prefix, GitError scanning covers only this run's events, and _compose_retro is shared with drain. Keep all of it. The remaining work is mostly the missing tests the acceptance criteria require.

test_retro.py: add a selected-failure case through main(['retro']). Use a failing or suppressed scripted retro LLM and assert the exact 'retro: no report committed; inspect status and the Suggestion Box' output, rc == 1, and no tickets/retro file.

test_retro.py: add a case where the report git op fails. Assert refusal rendering and rc == 2. Also show that an earlier retro_failed or suppression record in the journal does not change this run's exit class.

test_cli.py: through main(['doctor']), assert the exact full output and rc 0 when all checks pass, and 'doctor: failed' with rc 2 when any fails. For retro, assert exits 0/1/2 with exact output, plus config, construction, and journal-corruption refusals with exit 2.

test_verbs.py: prove dispatch through main(). doctor runs with no pipeline factory call, no provider, and no lock. retro takes the lock and invokes the governed Retro with trigger 'manual' and forced=True, e.g. via a scripted pipeline that records the retro request.

test_doctor.py: run the real probe_lock and read_events against a tmp state dir (missing lock, free lock, held live Lockfile). Snapshot the tree before and after to prove nothing is written. Assert the 0/2 exit mapping.

probe_lock takes LOCK_EX on a free lock, so a concurrent daemon acquire can be refused. Probe without contending (e.g. LOCK_SH, or a read-only holder-record check), or add a why-comment accepting the race. Pin the chosen behavior with a test.
Before reporting ok, map every acceptance criterion and every exit branch to a named test. Two attempts have now ignored lessons that already named these same test gaps.
reason: Second attempt still misses most of the test coverage that prior lessons named explicitly; the steering is not landing at the current capability.
